content_sections.heading: HLL Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the HLL Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download HLL Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for HLL Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by HLL Lifecare Limited (HLL) for positions at their Kanagala Factory under the Training & Development Scheme.

faq.question: Q2. What positions are available in HLL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions include ITI Trainee and SSLC Trainee across various trades such as Fitter, Electrician, Welder, Turner, AC Mechanic, and Machinist.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for HLL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via Walk-in interview. Candidates do not need to submit any prior online applications before attending.

faq.question: Q4. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for HLL ITI Trainee and SSLC Trainee posts is scheduled to be held on 05 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for ITI Trainee?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed ITI with a minimum of 60% marks in relevant trades including Fitter, Electrician, Welder, Turner, AC Mechanic, or Machinist.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for SSLC Trainee?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the SSLC Trainee position must have passed the SSLC examination.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for ITI Trainee and SSLC Trainee?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years for ITI trainees and 30 years for SSLC trainees, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary or stipend offered for these posts?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from ₹9,000 to ₹12,000 per month depending on the specific year of training and the trade assigned to the candidate.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry copies of educational qualification certificates, community certificates, and recent passport-size photographs along with valid ID proofs.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for HLL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for attending the walk-in interview.
